task.title: P6-043: Add a catalog equivalent of probe:paging to assert no duplicate or skipped rows
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 4 — Correctness, Catalog, search and paging). Original id: P6-043. Size: S. Specs: specs/catalog-search.md, specs/ui-work-loop.md.

**No catalog equivalent of `probe:paging`** — nothing walks the whole search keyset asserting no duplicate or skipped rows across page boundaries; it is covered only by the `#[ignore]`d `query_engine` test. Related and cheap once `P6-083` lands: a corrupt cursor surfaces as `ApiError::Validation`, so the UI renders "invalid cursor" in the *query* error box even though the query is fine.
